landing.title: Every ship in the 'verse. Your whole fleet in one place.
landing.lede: Look up any ship, its stats and loadouts as they are in the game today. Track your hangar, plan with your org, and see what each patch changed.

features.title: What you can do here
features.subline: Free for every pilot. It starts with your hangar.

hangar.title: Hangar
hangar.text: Sync your pledges from RSI, then group them, add paints and upgrades, keep a wishlist and share it all with one link.

fleets.title: Fleets
fleets.text: Run your org: events with sign-ups, announcements, contracts, a shared inventory, and who is online right now.

ships.title: Ships
ships.text: Every ship and vehicle with the stats, hardpoints and components the game files give it.

compare.title: Compare
compare.text: Put ships side by side, from cargo grids to quantum fuel.

trade.title: Trade
trade.text: Commodity prices with their history, and the best routes between terminals.

patches.title: Patches
patches.text: See which ships each new build changed, and by how much.

patch.title: This patch
patch.subline: Straight from the game files, updated with every build.

gameEvents.title: In the 'verse
gameEvents.subline: What is on in the game, picked by the Fleetyards team.

signUpPanel.title: Bring your hangar
signUpPanel.text: Sign up, sync from RSI, and your fleet is here in about a minute.
